name: تحديد متى يرسب الطالب في المقرر (الحالة 1)
description: بناء برنامج لتحديد ما إذا كان الطالب يرسب في المقرر بناءً على المدخلات التي يتلقاها من المدرس. الطالب يرسب إذا كانت درجة الامتحان أقل من 55 أو إذا كان لدى الطالب أكثر من واجبتين مفقودتين.
code:
#Khatwa 1: Qra wa mu'alaja madkholat al-modarris
text = input("Adkhil darajat al-imtihan:")
exam_score = int(text)
text = input("Adkhil 'adad al-wagibat al-mafqudah:")
number_of_missing_hw = int(text)
#Khatwa 2: Aktub ibarah booliyah litaqdir in kana al-talib yarsub fi al-muqarrar
is_failing = exam_score < 55 or number_of_missing_hw > 2
#Khatwa 3: Taba'a al-nateeja
if is_failing == True :
    print("Na'am! al-talib yarsub fi al-muqarrar.")
else:
    print("La! al-talib la yarsub fi al-muqarrar.")

untr_name: Determining When a Student Fails a Course (Case 1)
untr_description: Construct a program to determine whether a student fails the course based on the inputs that it receives from the instructor. The student fails the course if the exam score is less than 55 or student has more than 2 missing homework.
untr_code:
#Step 1: Read the instructor inputs
text = input("Enter the exam score:")
exam_score = int(text)
text = input("Enter number of missing homework:")
number_of_missing_hw = int(text)
#Step 2: Write the boolean expression to determine whether the student fails the course
is_failing = exam_score < 55 or number_of_missing_hw > 2
#Step 3: Print the result
if is_failing == True :
    print("Yes! The student fails the course.")
else:
    print("No! The student does not fail the course.")
